mentions.name: Visionary
mentions.description: A browser plugin called Visionary that overlays meaningful descriptions and context directly onto stunning pictures of the day. It harnesses modern AI to distill complex photo descriptions into accessible insights and provides references for exploring the core concepts in a photo more deeply.
mentions.problem: Existing picture-of-the-day browser plugins were built over two decades ago and never evolved to harness the capabilities of modern artificial intelligence.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built a browser plugin called "Visionary" that overlays meaningful descriptions and context directly onto stunning pictures of the day.
